remarks: "The Common" is a medium-sized condo/townhouse community located in historic Lockport. Minutes away from Lake Ontario and The Erie Canal. Easy commute to Buffalo, Amherst and Niagara Falls. Extremely well-maintained grounds and common areas. Features a lovely Gazebo and many mature trees. This end Unit boasts 1742sqft of gorgeous living space. Every room has had a complete face lift bringing a new chapter and elegance. The kitchen has a custom tile backsplash along with stunning granite countertops. There is a functional island and beautiful hardwood cabinets. Amazing luxury vinyl flooring in kitchen and dining room. Sliding door also gives easy access to perfectly-sized deck along with the 2 car garage. Freshly painted interior in todays most popular colors. Dining room with modern lighting and open staircase. Livingroom has soft, high quality carpeting. There are custom blinds and soft ceiling lights to keep you and your guests comfortable. The central focus is the custom, gas fireplace and stone wall with custom mantle. Convenient 1st floor half bath. The entire 2nd floor has the same, soft carpet through the hall and bedrooms. The primary bedroom has its own bath with tile floor and shower. There is also an over-sized walk-in closet and custom blinds. The main bath features subway tile around tub area. The two additional bedrooms are nicely appointed with ample closet space, custom blinds and ceiling fans. There is a full basement where you will find the laundry and the general mechanics for the home. All windows were replaced around 8 years ago. You are allowed 1 dog under 25# or up to 2 cats. No more then 2 pets per unit.
